result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed. The main defect is a data-binding error: the delivery fee for Smash Bros Burgers shows "€NaN delivery". Smaller issues affect the visual consistency of the promo banner and the low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card in the "Fastest near you" row shows "€NaN delivery" instead of a real delivery fee. This is a data or formatting bug (a failed number calculation or missing value). It looks broken and untrustworthy, and users can't tell what delivery will cost.
issues.suggestion: Fix the fee calculation or data binding. Validate that the value is numeric before formatting it. If the fee is unavailable, show a fallback such as "Delivery fee at checkout" or hide the field.

issues.description: The secondary text is light grey on a white or light background, and the search placeholder and delivery/meta lines are also light. This gives low contrast and hurts readability. The inactive tab labels in the bottom bar have the same problem.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The time badge on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps the plate image and looks cramped. The decorative circles in the promo banner are also cut off oddly at its edges, with a hard-edged shape at the bottom right corner.
issues.suggestion: Give the badge consistent spacing from the image and keep it clear of the main subject. Clean up the banner's decorative shapes so they clip smoothly within the rounded corners.
